scheme_name: Labour Accident benefit Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The worker must have become disabled during the duty period at the establishment’s premises
The organization/unit must have regularly paid the Labour Welfare Fund for the last one year
The application must be filed within 2 years of the accident
Proof of payment of Labour Welfare Fund by the organization must be submitted
The decision of the Welfare Commissioner is final and jurisdiction is Ahmedabad
benefits_summary: Workers with 40‑70% disability receive a benefit of ₹25,000, while those with more than 70% disability receive ₹50,000.
documents_required: Proof of Labour Welfare Fund payment by the organization
